notes.title: The Allen Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/7a0a02e83b57a95ce0f644902b54f031a1e98c95.png[/img]

It's here! It's finally here! For a limited time only, the Allen DLC is on sale for 50% off and a super low-low price of $9.99! 

Ok, Ok, we're gonna stop with the BS... This joke didn't work the last time we tried it which made us wonder if it's the sarcasm that got lost in text form or if the people reading the announcements were way more stoned than we were writing them...

Anyway, if you're trying to read this after smoking a fat one and still don't understand what's going on, let us spell it out for you:
WE'VE JUST RELEASED A HUGE CONTENT UPDATE WHICH IS FREE (assuming that you own a copy of Weed Shop 2).

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]ALLEN PART 1[/h1]
Smoke yourself out into another dimension, make some new friends or foes and unlock intergalactic artifacts and paraphernalia.

[h1]ALLEN PART 2[/h1]
Sell your weed in bulk and make monster one-time deals. Earn the cartel's respect and reap the rewards or say goodbye to your kneecaps.

[h1]ALLEN PART 3[/h1]
Get turnt up at the beach events hosted by Allen and sell mad edibles while you're at it.

All in all, the Allen Update comes with 30 new missions and 28 brand new items, however, you'll only get to see them by leveling up and completing missions.

Just a heads up, we're taking a little vacay starting now, so there's not going to be any new content for a couple of weeks. Hope you guys are having an awesome Summer and see you again in August. Peace!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/7bea1043ebd2c22c19787584e00aeffc122ef0a3.png[/img]

Oh s***, waddup! 
So some of you have been blowing up our DMs asking when we gonna be putting out new content. And the answer is TODAY!

JK! Seriously though, we've been working on a bunch of new content based on the best ideas from the Steam & Twitch communities as well as some of the worst ideas we could come up with. However, instead of releasing free incremental updates on a daily basis, we've decided to turn it into a DLC which will be available for purchase in July for a low-low price of $19.99!

We just playin! The upcoming update, as well as any future updates, will always be free! The reason it's being delayed though is that for once we'd like to release a major update which doesn't break the game, and play-testing this thing is taking forever... 

So while we can't give you an exact ETA, we can guarantee that this update will either turn out Epic or end up sucking Randy's nuts... also no multiplayer. Peace!

notes.title: The Summer Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/8c9c001e97831439cc6e928e1bcee7169caa897b.png[/img]

What's up Weed Gang! So... it's been a crazy couple of weeks at the dumpster, we meant ADhD Studios, and here's what happened:

After being mentioned on [url=https://hightimes.com/culture/what-are-the-best-weed-games/]www.hightimes.com[/url], Weed Shop 2 got picked up by a bunch of Twitch streamers including JoshOG. If you're one of the few people who don't know who JoshOG is, check out his Twitch stream at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/joshog]https://www.twitch.tv/joshog[/url] It's sick!

Anyway, his people reached out to us for some collab action and a week later we busted out the Summer Update featuring JoshOG, which ended up breaking the game twice. However, after a bunch of sleepless nights, we've managed to work out all the major bugs and the game was finally playable again!

We didn't stop there, however, and kept adding and fixing a bunch of stuff!

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]JOSHOG[/h1]
Hire Josh to do any job you require, grow the weedFaded hydro strain and take a hit from the Ducks Fly Together community bong!

[h1]INTERACTIVE TRASH[/h1]
Clean up the beach by picking up trash, roaches and sometimes even cash!

[h1]MASTER BLASTER[/h1]
Got plenty of trash, use it as ammo for the Master Blaster! WTF is a Master Blaster?

[h1]HYDRO RECIPES[/h1]
Keep an eye out for pages ripped out from the Hydro Grower's Manual and hang them on your grow room walls.

[h1]NO HYDRO SIGN[/h1]
Turn on the No Hydro sign when you're running low on hydro stock and your customers will stop asking for it.

[h1]INCREASED HYDRO PRICES[/h1]
To give you the incentive to grow Hydro strains, we've increased hydro weed prices by a whopping 25%!

[h1]IMPROVED STAFF PERFORMANCE[/h1]
Some of the staff was pretty useless, to say the least, so we've improved security and grow staff performance by 30%.

[h1]BUTTLOAD OF OTHER FIXES[/h1]
We've also fixed a ton of minor bugs reported in twitch chat, via the bug report tool and here in the community discussions.


By the way, we really value all your suggestions and constructive criticism! Even if we don't reply to every single post, rest assured we read them all. So keep them coming! 

Allen Part 1 - COMING SOON!

notes.title: The Back To School Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/7dd8c28651ece5ca14d2c9588c1a023717f1d20b.png[/img]

"But school started a month ago..."

Yeah? Well, we never went to one so we don't know no better. Also, we've been working on something really dope and totally lost track of time... While the content update is not quite there yet, we've just published a brand new patch which should fix most of the reported bugs.

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]BUG REPORT TOOLS[/h1]
Use the bug report feature to report any bugs or glitches as soon as they happen. Attaching relevant screenshots and describing the issue in detail will help us get the bugs fixed ASAP and in turn, give us more time to work on new content.

[h1]PIMP YOUR SHOP TASK FIX[/h1]
Fixed a bug that prevented the Pimp Yo Shop & Upgrade missions from being completed.

[h1]WEED DIPLOMA & STORE SIGN FIX[/h1]
Fixed a bug where typing the shop name would cause all the controls and UI to freeze.

[h1]NPC PATHFINDING IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Improved pathfinding and local avoidance in order to reduce the instances of customers getting stuck inside the shop.

[h1]CUSTOMER ANIMATIONS FIX[/h1]
So not pointing fingers here but someone, working under the influence, decided to disable all the interaction animations. Sorry about that!

[h1]LOADING SCREEN CRASH FIX[/h1]
If it still crashes on your pc get in touch with us with your hardware specs though.

notes.title: The Summer Sale Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/24dd6d9920087d65362f43efaee8bf9c25b5500d.png[/img]

The Hydro Weed Update is finally here!

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]HYDRO SETUPS[/h1]
Forget about watering plants or dealing with mold and mites. The hydro setups grow your weed from start to finish with minimal maintenance.

[h1]HYDRO STRAINS[/h1]
Growing hydro weed will require some experimenting in order to find the right balance of light, water and nutrients. That balance differs from strain to strain and will affect the maximum yield.

[h1]HYDRO PARTS[/h1]
The grow settings affect the longevity of your hydro setup's components. Running the lights, pump or nutrient supply at full capacity will cause them to break down sooner. 

[h1]HYDRO CUSTOMERS[/h1] 
The new customers will want specific hydro weed strains so the days of stockpiling generic weed are over. Hey, you asked for it :)

[h1]HYDRO MISSIONS[/h1] 
Well technically they're not all hydro missions, a few of them are and the others aren't. The point is we got some new missions!

[h1]HYDRO WALLPAPERS[/h1]
Again, they're not hydro wallpapers (WTF is a hydro wallpaper anyway?) but we did add new wallpapers and shop signs in case you're tired of looking at the same walls for the third month now.

notes.title: The WTF Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/7fa4b88bde64c2e14ccaf5ef366e30c49d995bed.png[/img]

This week, after receiving reports of abysmal FPS when growing a crapload of weed, we spent most of our time optimizing the game's performance. Now, on a decent PC, you'll be able to grow up to a 100 plants with no noticeable impact on performance!

Since we spent a lot of time optimizing stuff, this week's content update is totally weaksauce, but we got that sweet "Major Features" image made anyway.

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]SMOKE SPOT[/h1] Get one and smoke your bongs without leaving your shop.

[h1]MARIJUANA DEGREE[/h1] Someone's been asking for a way to give yourself a name. Here it is! You can also name your store by buying banners now!

[h1]CAT[/h1] 
If this is your cat, please call Tyler.

[h1]ACTION KEY MAPS[/h1] 
For those of you who hate using the mouse pointer to do things, we've mapped the action buttons to keyboard keys.

And in case you missed it, Weed Shop 2 trading cards are now live so you can finally collect that "pimp cup filled with weed" emoticon you've been dreaming of!

notes.title: Bongs, Bats, Balloons & More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28297170/5abe4cf269c6617ceb15affc57afecf810608960.png[/img]

The new content update is finally here with an extra dose of weed growing, head bashing, merch flipping insanity! 

[b]WEED SHOP 2 NOW FEATURES[/b]

[h1]BONGS[/h1] Diversify your business by selling weed paraphernalia to your existing customer base.

[h1]UPGRADEABLE BATS[/h1] Visit the Upgrades section to buy a short stick or upgrade to something more lethal.

[h1]JUGGALOS[/h1] They'll snatch and grab your bong right from your hands before you even have the chance to exhale.

[h1]CCTV CAMERAS[/h1] Get alerts as soon as a known criminal enters your shop.

[h1]YOUTUBE TV[/h1] Watch youtube videos while waiting for your next harvest. (Highly experimental at the moment and could cause performance issues on older PCs)

[h1]UNBREAKABLE POTS[/h1] As the title implies, they don't ever break, ever!

[h1]MORE MISSIONS & ITEMS[/h1] Complete new tasks and purchase even more random stuff for your shop.

[h1]ADDITIONAL KEYBOARD MAPS[/h1] Use the Q & E keys to select other pots and plants on the same grow setup. (Action key maps coming real soon!)

[h1]STEAM CARDS[/h1] Our initial batch of emoticons and backgrounds got rejected for containing drug references, so we hope you enjoy our new fluffy kitten backgrounds and office supply emoticons!

[h1]MORE BUGS[/h1] If anything glitches out, let us know by making a new thread at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/617700/discussions/1/]Bug Reports[/url] and we'll get it fixed ASAP!

More stuff on the way next week, have a lit weekend everyone!

notes.title: Weed Shop 2 Update 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
We're super excited to announce that our latest patch 1.0.2.0 is out now! 

Ok, that was a lie, we got no version control and have released way too many patches to count so the fancy version number was complete BS... also not all that excited... somewhat excited... as excited as waiting for the piss test results...

Anyway, here's what's changed since the 420 announcement:

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Hippy Jeff Is A Woman - FIXED
    [*]Achievents Slow/Stoned - FIXED
    [*]Missing Ganjaroids - FIXED
    [*]Wrong Name Shown For Flying Turd - FIXED
    [*]Can't Place Medium Setup - FIXED
    [*]Mission Ye's Bodyguard - FIXED
    [*]Player Out Of Map - FIXED
    [*]Thug Stuck In Attack Mode - FIXED
    [*]Sales Staff Not Doing Their Job - FIXED
    [*]Not Being Able To Get High - IN PROGRESS
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added the option to sell your old s**t.
    [*]Replaced SFX & Music toggles with volume controls.
    [*]Added mouse view sensitivity options. 
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]
[list]
    [*]"Hella Stoned"
    [*]New Missions
    [*]Game Guide - That s**t's hard to write, yo!
[/list]

If you got any requests, suggestions or bugs to report, hit us up on the community forums or hook us up with some malt liquor (both preferably) and we'll do our best to make something happen.

By the way, and this is the only serious part of this post, big props to all the bros making let's play videos, streaming on twitch and spreading the word on social media! We owe you one!

notes.title: Weed Shop 2 Update 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Weed Shop 2 patch 1.0.1.0 has just been released! It should address most of the reported bugs and improve the gameplay mechanics based on your suggestions.

Here's the current status of Weed Shop 2 (1.0.1.0):

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Falling through the floor when using shortcuts - FIXED
    [*]Stuck/Floating timers after harvesting - FIXED
    [*]Customers getting stuck - FIXED
    [*]Shop sign not increasing popularity - FIXED
    [*]Crackhead Mack mission - FIXED
    [*]Missing V-sync - FIXED
    [*]Reset/Load/Save progress glitches - FIXED
    [*]Staff not doing their jobs - IN PROGRESS
    [*]Not being able to beat robbers up - BY DESIGN (We'll have more info on this in the upcoming game guide)
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
    [*]More free grow supplies and blunts when starting from scratch
    [*]XP points increase based on weed harvest size, sale prices and player level
    [*]Increased the potential customer count & shop visit frequency
    [*]Increased the number of NPCs
    [*]Adjusted player movement for tighter controls
[/list]

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Gameplay Guide
    [*]Custom Mapping Support
    [*]Steam Exclusive Rolling Tables
    [*]Custom Joints
    [*]Mistery Strains
    [*]Stoner Tasks
    [*]Visual Improvements
[/list]

Stay lit and stay tuned!

notes.title: What up homies!
notes.notes:
First of all, we want to thank all of you who helped us get Weed Shop 2 Greenlit!

As you can probably tell from all the f-ups, Weed Shop 2 is our first Steam release ever but we've been working non-stop to get all the bugs fixed ASAP! (Also, each sentence in the update is going to end with an exclamation point thanks to a mother****ing Cheeto stuck under the period key!)

Anyway, thanks for all the reviews, bug reports and comments! Keep that s**t coming and we'll have a perfect weed game in no time! We've fixed most of the reported bugs and have begun implementing gameplay changes based on your feedback! 

We'll be posting a detailed list of bugfixes, improvements and upcoming add-ons as soon as the next patch goes live!

Stay tuned and stay lit!
